opinions.text: Motions of the National Trust for Historic Preservation in the United States et al., New York Landmarks Conservancy et al., and New York Historical Society et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Exceptions to the Report of the Special Master are set for oral argument in due course. Motion of New York for leave to file a surre-ply brief denied. [For earlier order herein, see, e. g., ante, p. 1116.]
